home.amuni_text: Amunì is not just an invitation to travel, it is the embrace of our land. It means 'let's do it together': don't just watch from afar, but step into the pulse of the village. When we say Amunì, we are erasing the boundary between those who arrive and those who stay, to make every step a shared discovery.
home.castellana_intro_text: Talk to the Castellana: your multilingual tour guide to discover stories, hidden gems, and gourmet routes among the wonders of the village and the surrounding area.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, o travelers, to the mighty manor,
gazing over the valley and history present.
Perched on the mountain of proud living stone,
guardian of dreams, of glory, and mystery.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that defy time,
dynasties passed like a breath in the wind.
From the proud, adventurous Chiaramonte family,
each room tells of pacts and splendor.
castle.rhyme_3:
Do not look for dates in a cold volume,
but for the shadow dancing as the candle fades.
The Castellana awaits you, in the steps and the way,
to reveal the secret of Sister Felicia.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Chamber of Conspiracies, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a commanding view over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol walkways recount its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble chambers were the stage for medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still hold the traces of ancient incarcerations.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and evocative interior halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalrous legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of the Sicilian Baroque, the church is famous worldwide for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, which depicts allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare craftsmanship. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular services, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU youth 18-25 or with same-day Castle ticket) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and works of sacred art that bear witness to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece that dominates the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gagini school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, to the rich chapels decorated in mixed marble.
sangiorgio.hours: Visiting Hours: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Set in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its façade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality felt inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and the faithful.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday masses 18:00. Sundays and holidays visits in slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive masses 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Capuchin Friars Convent
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the convent structure, the area offers an authentic glimpse of monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time opening hours for lesser-known treasures such as the Church of San Rocco and other small scattered masterpieces.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith and memory,
open their doors to a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli rests, in the most sacred silence,
Blessed Giovanni, the village's icon.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you go down to the Badia, the earth turns to flower
in the majolica embroidery of rare splendor.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the great Duomo, majestic and solemn,
among Gagini's marbles and the perennial Stomer.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata reveals its painted vaults,
and the bell tower never conquered by guards.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Finally climb to the Cappuccini, on the radiant hill,
between an Altarpiece and a majestic panorama.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stopped...

transport_page.welcome: Welcome, traveler, to the Transport section. Here you will find the necessary information to move around the surroundings of the village.
transport_page.company_desc: The bus lines connect Caccamo to Termini Imerese and Palermo all year round. By taking the afternoon trip to Palermo, it is possible to get off at Vetrana, a renowned seaside area. From Termini Imerese you can also take the train to Cefalù and other tourist destinations.
transport_page.stop_1: Porta Euracea: in front of Bar Giallombardo and the building materials shop.
transport_page.stop_2: Viale Regione Siciliana: above the 'Roberta' playground (near the Axa insurance agency).
transport_page.stop_3: Piazza Cappuccini: in the shade of the ancient Convent.

events_page.title: Rites and Festivals of the Village
events_page.intro: Experience the most authentic soul of our village through its centuries-old traditions, where faith, history, and folklore intertwine in unique and emotional moments.
events_page.signuruzzu_desc: On Palm Sunday, a local child impersonates Jesus and parades on a donkey adorned through the streets of the village, which are decked out for the celebration with palms. The procession stops in front of the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli and the Duomo of San Giorgio Martire for the evocative blessing.
events_page.venerdi_desc: The atmosphere becomes profound with the altars set up in the churches for Good Friday, enriched with the typical dishes of wheat sprouted in the dark. These are followed by the solemn and moving Procession and the town Via Crucis.
events_page.giovanni_desc: A deeply felt recurrence experienced by the entire community, which gathers around its Blessed in a climate of great devotion and popular warmth.
events_page.castellana_title: Election of the Castellana & Historical Parade
events_page.castellana_desc: The village dives back into its glorious medieval past. A majestic historical parade in period costumes crosses the streets, culminating with the solemn election of the Lady of the Manor.
events_page.nicasio_title: Feast of San Nicasio and the Palio
events_page.nicasio_desc: Vibrant celebrations in honor of the Saint, enriched by the highly anticipated and gripping town Palio that ignites the challenge and enthusiasm of young and old.
events_page.sagra_desc: Every year, on October 12th, the scents of tradition invade the village. An unmissable gastronomic appointment to taste the authentic local sausage amidst songs, wine, and conviviality.
